project_name: Minecraft Education Edition - Complete Mace Weapon Add-on
description: Full Mace Weapon Add-on in a single JSON file for easy deployment

commands.mcfunction:
# Mace Special Abilities Command File
# This file contains command blocks that simulate mace abilities

# ABILITY 1: Apply Blindness Effect (simulates hit effect)
# Use with: /execute @s ~ ~ ~ effect @s blindness 3 0
effect @s blindness 3 0

# ABILITY 2: Apply Weakness Effect (simulates hit effect)
# Use with: /execute @s ~ ~ ~ effect @s weakness 4 0
effect @s weakness 4 0

# ABILITY 3: Extra Damage on Critical Hit
# Use with: /execute @s ~ ~ ~ damage @s 8
damage @s 8

# ABILITY 4: Teleport Dash Ability (right-click simulation)
# Use with: /execute @s ~ ~ ~ tp @s ^ ^ ^6
tp @s ^ ^ ^6

# ABILITY 5: Apply Invisibility Buff (after teleport)
# Use with: /effect @s invisibility 3 0
effect @s invisibility 3 0

# ABILITY 6: Play Sound Effect (teleport sound)
# Use with: /playsound block.end_portal.spawn hostile @s
playsound block.end_portal.spawn hostile @s

complete_setup_guide.title: Complete Minecraft Education Edition Mace Add-on Setup
complete_setup_guide.overview: This single JSON file contains everything needed to create a custom Mace Weapon in Minecraft Education Edition with all abilities included.

installation_windows.step_1: Extract this JSON file to a folder called 'mace-addon'
installation_windows.step_2: Open File Explorer and navigate to: %appdata%\.minecraft\
installation_windows.step_3: Create two folders if they don't exist: 'behavior_packs' and 'resource_packs'
installation_windows.step_8: Go to World Settings > Behavior Packs > Add 'Mace Weapon Behavior Pack'
installation_windows.step_9: Go to World Settings > Resource Packs > Add 'Mace Weapon Resource Pack'

installation_mac.step_1: Extract this JSON to a folder called 'mace-addon'
installation_mac.step_2: Open Finder and press Cmd + Shift + G
installation_mac.step_8: Create new world and enable both packs

installation_ipad.step_2: Open Files app > On My iPad > Minecraft > Documents
installation_ipad.step_4: Copy extracted folders to correct locations
installation_ipad.step_5: Open Minecraft Education and create world
installation_ipad.step_6: Enable both packs in world settings

usage.attack_command: Left-click enemy with mace to apply effects
usage.ability_command: Right-click while holding mace to teleport

command_blocks_setup.info: To automate effects, use these command blocks:

teleport_ability.description: Teleport 6 blocks forward and become invisible

commands: execute if score @s mace_cooldown >= 240 run scoreboard players reset @s mace_cooldown

customization.change_effects: Edit effect duration numbers in commands
customization.change_name: Edit 'value': '§c⚔ Mace Weapon' to custom name

addon_not_appearing: Verify manifest.json files have valid JSON
mace_not_spawning: Ensure behavior pack is enabled in world
incompatible_pack_error: Update Minecraft Education to latest version

tips.tip_1: Start in Creative Mode to test without survival concerns
tips.tip_2: Use repeating command blocks set to 'Always Active' for continuous effects
tips.tip_3: Use conditional command blocks to create complex logic chains
tips.tip_5: Watch console logs (F3 on PC) for error messages
tips.tip_6: Join Minecraft Education Community for advanced help
tips.tip_7: Scoreboards are useful for tracking cooldowns and stats
tips.tip_8: Test all effects in Creative Mode before using in Survival

q1.question: Can I use this on regular Minecraft Java Edition?
q1.answer: No, this is Education Edition only. Use Forge mods for Java Edition.

q2.question: Can I modify the mace appearance?

q3.question: How do I increase the cooldown timer?
q3.answer: Modify the cooldown value: 20 * 12 = 240 ticks. Change 12 to desired seconds.

q4.question: Can I add more abilities?
q4.answer: Yes, add more command blocks and JSON event handlers to the item definition.

q5.question: What versions of Minecraft Education does this support?
q5.answer: Minimum version 1.16.0+. Check your version in settings.

q6.question: Can I share this add-on with others?
q6.answer: Yes! Share the entire folder as a ZIP file or .mcaddon file.

deployment_script.description: Follow these steps to deploy the add-on:

step_by_step.details: Extract behavior_pack and resource_pack folders from this JSON structure
Create behavior_pack/manifest.json and behavior_pack/items/mace.json with the data above
Create resource_pack/manifest.json and resource_pack/items.json with the data above
Move both folders to your Minecraft Education add-ons directory
Click 'Create New World' to start setup
World Settings > Behavior Packs > Add 'Mace Weapon Behavior Pack'
World Settings > Resource Packs > Add 'Mace Weapon Resource Pack'
Click 'Create' to load your world with the mace addon
Use /give @s mace:mace_weapon to spawn the mace and test abilities

behavior_pack.items/mace.json: Mace item definition with all properties

ability_2_weakness.effect: Enemy deals less damage, breaks blocks slower

ability_7_cooldown.effect: Ability cannot be used until cooldown expires
